title: PushResult
description: The outcome of delivering a single Transaction to a destination. A destination's push() returns exactly one PushResult per input transaction, in the same order.

external_id.description: The external_id of the transaction this result is for.

status.description: 'created' = delivered; 'skipped' = the destination recognised it as a duplicate; 'error' = delivery failed (see 'error').

remote_id.description: Identifier the destination assigned, when available (used to link local <-> remote).

error.description: Human-readable failure reason when status is 'error' (or the duplicate marker when 'skipped').
